title: An Agent Architecture with Tools and Memory for Selective Correction of Wrist PPG Heart Rate Estimates
abstract: arXiv:2610.30688v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wrist photoplethysmography (PPG) heart rate estimates are vulnerable to motion artifacts, and corrections that reduce mean error can worsen individual windows. We propose an agent architecture with tools and memory around a fixed heart rate estimator. Pulse, motion, and limited historical evidence generate candidate estimates, whose predicted benefits and harms guide selection. An independent risk gate determines whether to retain, correct, or reject each output. We trained the architecture on PPG-DaLiA and tested it on Wrist Exercise, GalaxyPPG, and WildPPG with frozen weights. Across these four public datasets, mean absolute error (MAE), macro-averaged over ten estimators, decreased by up to 44.5%, with the largest reduction on GalaxyPPG. Beneficial and harmful corrections decreased and increased absolute error by more than 1 bpm, respectively. translated_title: 一种具备工具与记忆的智能体架构，用于手腕光电容积脉搏波（PPG）心率估计的选择性校正
translated_abstract: 手腕光电容积脉搏波（PPG）心率估计容易受到运动伪影的影响，而那些能降低平均误差的校正却可能使个别时间窗口的表现变差。我们提出了一种围绕固定心率估计器构建的、具备工具与记忆的智能体架构。脉搏、运动以及有限的历史证据用于生成候选估计值，候选估计的预测收益与危害则指导选择过程。一个独立的风险门控决定对每个输出是保留、校正还是拒绝。我们在PPG-DaLiA数据集上训练了该架构，并在冻结权重的情况下，在Wrist Exercise、GalaxyPPG和WildPPG数据集上进行了测试。在这四个公开数据集上，对十个估计器进行宏平均后的平均绝对误差（MAE）最多降低了44.5%，其中在GalaxyPPG上降幅最大。有益校正与有害校正分别使绝对误差降低和增加超过1 bpm，其十估计器宏平均比例分别在16.06%至36.64%和1.68%至……
tldr: 该论文提出一种带工具与记忆的智能体架构，通过独立风险门控对手腕PPG心率估计进行选择性校正，在四个公开数据集上使平均绝对误差最多降低44.5%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an agent architecture with tools and memory that selectively corrects wrist PPG heart rate estimates through an independent risk gate, reducing mean absolute error by up to 44.5% across four public datasets.
